title: H4: emit non-empty model attribution on MODEL_SERVED
agent_hint: Base 9b92c936. Harness._record_provenance in src/fleet/harness.py:733 emits MODEL_SERVED with served_models: [] and source: none when no gateway model is attributable (direct CLI or empty window). Change it so every MODEL_SERVED payload and bundle attribution carries a non-empty list: use the explicit sentinel [unavailable] with a non-none source such as unavailable when provenance is genuinely unknown, while preserving the real models/source when the gateway names them. Do not invent a model from profile.model. Add tests/fleet/test_model_attribution.py covering direct/no-model and real gateway model; keep fleet/provenance tests green.
